section_summary: This section continues an intelligence report on the Japan Communist Party. It reviews elections and attempts to form a united front, then describes party schools, Communist influence in labor unions, strike organization, and youth activities. The final page begins a discussion of youth assault groups that continues beyond this section.

subfiles.title: Report on Japan Communist Party activities
subfiles.about: The report assesses the party’s electoral strategy, training, labor influence, strike methods, and youth organizations.
subfiles.summary: Continuing from earlier pages, the report traces Communist election results from 1946 to January 1949 and describes repeated proposals for cooperation with the Social Democrats. It details party schools and argues that Communist minorities gained control of major industrial unions through their executive structures. It then describes strikes, alleged industrial sabotage, and the Young Communist League’s recruitment and assault groups. The youth section continues beyond page 254.
